function trisolve!(x, l, d, u, b)
    # Thomas algorithm, l is sub-diag (length n-1), d is diag after forward elimination, u is super-diag
    n = length(b)
    # Forward substitution
    cp = zeros(n)
    y = zeros(n)
    cp[1] = d[1]
    y[1] = b[1]
    for i in 2:n
        w = l[i-1] / cp[i-1]
        cp[i] = d[i] - w * u[i-1]
        y[i] = b[i] - w * y[i-1]
    end
    # Back substitution
    x[n] = y[n] / cp[n]
    for i in n-1:-1:1
        x[i] = (y[i] - u[i] * x[i+1]) / cp[i]
    end
    return nothing
end

    ωv = θ[2]
    ωc = θ[3]

    S.xold .= x

    # Solve for update along each horizontal line
    δ = zeros(n)

        for i in 1:N

            bline[i] = r[idx]
        end

    matvec!(r, P, δ)
    S.rtmp .-= r  # new residual = old r - A*δ
    r .= S.rtmp
    
    # === Post-smoothing: vertical line relaxation ===
    δ .= 0
    for i in 1:N
        bline = zeros(N)
        for j in 1:N
            idx = i + N*(j-1)
            bline[j] = r[idx]
        end
        xline = zeros(N)

        end

    x .+= δ
    # Update residual

    matvec!(r, P, δ)
    S.rtmp .-= r
    r .= S.rtmp

    # Restrict residual
    S.e .= 0
    for ci in 1:C.nc, cj in 1:C.nc

        s = 0.0
        i0 = (ci-1)*C.ratio

# Multilevel solver with alternating line relaxation and coarse grid correction.
# Pre-smoothing: horizontal lines, coarse correction, post-smoothing: vertical lines.

const THETA0 = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5]
const LOWER = [0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.0]
const UPPER = [2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0]
const THETA_NAMES = ["omega_pre", "omega_post", "omega_c", "beta"]

function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    nc = 8
    ratio = N ÷ nc
    
    # Build coarse k by averaging
    kc = zeros(nc, nc)
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        i0 = (ci-1)*ratio
        j0 = (cj-1)*ratio
        s = 0.0
        for jj in 1:ratio, ii in 1:ratio
            s += P.k[i0+ii, j0+jj]
        end
        kc[ci, cj] = s / (ratio*ratio)
    end
    
    # Build coarse 5-point matrix
    ncoarse = nc * nc
    Ac = zeros(ncoarse, ncoarse)
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        idx = ci + nc*(cj-1)
        # west
        if ci > 1
            tw = 2.0 / (1.0/kc[ci,cj] + 1.0/kc[ci-1,cj])
            Ac[idx, idx] += tw
            Ac[idx, idx-1] = -tw
        else
            tw = 2.0 * kc[ci,cj]
            Ac[idx, idx] += tw
        end
        # east
        if ci < nc
            te = 2.0 / (1.0/kc[ci,cj] + 1.0/kc[ci+1,cj])
            Ac[idx, idx] += te
            Ac[idx, idx+1] = -te
        else
            te = 2.0 * kc[ci,cj]
            Ac[idx, idx] += te
        end
        # south
        if cj > 1
            ts = 2.0 / (1.0/kc[ci,cj] + 1.0/kc[ci,cj-1])
            Ac[idx, idx] += ts
            Ac[idx, idx-nc] = -ts
        else
            ts = 2.0 * kc[ci,cj]
            Ac[idx, idx] += ts
        end
        # north
        if cj < nc
            tn = 2.0 / (1.0/kc[ci,cj] + 1.0/kc[ci,cj+1])
            Ac[idx, idx] += tn
            Ac[idx, idx+nc] = -tn
        else
            tn = 2.0 * kc[ci,cj]
            Ac[idx, idx] += tn
        end
    end
    
    F = cholesky(Symmetric(Ac))
    
    # Precompute tridiagonal factors for horizontal lines
    Lh = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    Dh = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    Uh = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    for j in 1:N
        d = zeros(N)
        l = zeros(N-1)
        u = zeros(N-1)
        for i in 1:N
            idx = i + N*(j-1)
            d[i] = P.diag[idx]
            if i < N
                u[i] = -P.te[i,j]
                l[i] = -P.tw[i+1,j]
            end
        end
        cp = zeros(N)
        cp[1] = d[1]
        for i in 2:N
            w = l[i-1] / cp[i-1]
            cp[i] = d[i] - w * u[i-1]
        end
        Lh[j] = l
        Dh[j] = cp
        Uh[j] = u
    end
    
    # Vertical lines
    Lv = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    Dv = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    Uv = Vector{Vector{Float64}}(undef, N)
    for i in 1:N
        d = zeros(N)
        l = zeros(N-1)
        u = zeros(N-1)
        for j in 1:N
            idx = i + N*(j-1)
            d[j] = P.diag[idx]
            if j < N
                u[j] = -P.tn[i,j]
                l[j] = -P.ts[i,j+1]
            end
        end
        cp = zeros(N)
        cp[1] = d[1]
        for j in 2:N
            w = l[j-1] / cp[j-1]
            cp[j] = d[j] - w * u[j-1]
        end
        Lv[i] = l
        Dv[i] = cp
        Uv[i] = u
    end
    
    return (F=F, Lh=Lh, Dh=Dh, Uh=Uh, Lv=Lv, Dv=Dv, Uv=Uv, ratio=ratio, nc=nc, N=N)
end

function init(P, C, θ)
    n = P.n
    ncoarse = C.nc * C.nc
    return (
        xprev = zeros(n),
        xold = zeros(n),
        res = zeros(n),
        res_old = zeros(n),
        e = zeros(ncoarse),
        ytmp = zeros(ncoarse),
        C = C,
        bline = zeros(C.N),
        xline = zeros(C.N),
        δ = zeros(n),
        cp_work = zeros(C.N),
        y_work = zeros(C.N),
    )
end

function trisolve!(x, l, d, u, b, cp_work, y_work, n)
    cp_work[1] = d[1]
    y_work[1] = b[1]
    for i in 2:n
        w = l[i-1] / cp_work[i-1]
        cp_work[i] = d[i] - w * u[i-1]
        y_work[i] = b[i] - w * y_work[i-1]
    end
    x[n] = y_work[n] / cp_work[n]
    for i in n-1:-1:1
        x[i] = (y_work[i] - u[i] * x[i+1]) / cp_work[i]
    end
    return nothing
end

function step!(x, r, P, S, θ)
    N = S.C.N
    n = P.n
    nc = S.C.nc
    ratio = S.C.ratio
    ω_pre = θ[1]
    ω_post = θ[2]
    ωc = θ[3]
    β = θ[4]
    
    S.xold .= x
    S.res .= r
    
    # === Pre-smoothing: horizontal line relaxation ===
    S.δ .= 0
    for j in 1:N
        for i in 1:N
            S.bline[i] = S.res[i + N*(j-1)]
        end
        trisolve!(S.xline, S.C.Lh[j], S.C.Dh[j], S.C.Uh[j], S.bline, S.cp_work, S.y_work, N)
        for i in 1:N
            S.δ[i + N*(j-1)] = ω_pre * S.xline[i]
        end
    end
    x .+= S.δ
    
    # Update residual for coarse correction
    S.res_old .= S.res
    matvec!(S.res, P, S.δ)
    S.res .= S.res_old .- S.res
    
    # === Coarse grid correction ===
    # Restrict residual by averaging
    S.e .= 0
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        cidx = ci + nc*(cj-1)
        i0 = (ci-1)*ratio
        j0 = (cj-1)*ratio
        s = 0.0
        for jj in 1:ratio, ii in 1:ratio
            s += S.res[i0+ii + N*(j0+jj-1)]
        end
        S.e[cidx] = s / (ratio*ratio)
    end
    
    # Solve coarse system
    ldiv!(S.ytmp, S.C.F, S.e)
    
    # Prolongate (piecewise constant) and correct
    S.δ .= 0
    for cj in 1:nc, ci in 1:nc
        cidx = ci + nc*(cj-1)
        val = ωc * S.ytmp[cidx]
        i0 = (ci-1)*ratio
        j0 = (cj-1)*ratio
        for jj in 1:ratio, ii in 1:ratio
            S.δ[i0+ii + N*(j0+jj-1)] = val
        end
    end
    x .+= S.δ
    
    # Update residual for post-smoothing
    S.res_old .= S.res
    matvec!(S.res, P, S.δ)
    S.res .= S.res_old .- S.res
    
    # === Post-smoothing: vertical line relaxation ===
    S.δ .= 0
    for i in 1:N
        for j in 1:N
            S.bline[j] = S.res[i + N*(j-1)]
        end
        trisolve!(S.xline, S.C.Lv[i], S.C.Dv[i], S.C.Uv[i], S.bline, S.cp_work, S.y_work, N)
        for j in 1:N
            S.δ[i + N*(j-1)] = ω_post * S.xline[j]
        end
    end
    x .+= S.δ
    
    # === Momentum ===
    x .+= β .* (S.xold .- S.xprev)
    S.xprev .= S.xold
    
    return nothing
end

    S.res .= S.res_old .- S.res

    S.δ .= 0
    for i in 1:N

        trisolve!(S.xline, S.C.Lv[i], S.C.Dv[i], S.C.Uv[i], S.bline, S.cp_work, S.y_work, N)

        end
    end
    x .+= S.δ
    
    # === Momentum ===
    x .+= β .* (S.xold .- S.xprev)
    S.xprev .= S.xold
    
    return nothing

# Coarse space: connected high-conductivity components + 8x8 geometric aggregates.
# Smoother: weighted Jacobi pre/post.

function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    n = N * N
    k = P.k
    
    # Adaptive threshold based on contrast
    k_max = maximum(k)
    k_threshold = max(k_max / 10.0, 1.0)
    
    # Find connected components of high-k cells
    visited = falses(N, N)
    components = Vector{Int}[]
    
    for j in 1:N
        for i in 1:N
            if !visited[i,j] && k[i,j] > k_threshold
                comp = Int[]
                stack = [(i,j)]
                while !isempty(stack)
                    ci, cj = pop!(stack)
                    (ci < 1 || ci > N || cj < 1 || cj > N) && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] && continue
                    k[ci,cj] <= k_threshold && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] = true
                    push!(comp, ci + N*(cj-1))
                    push!(stack, (ci-1,cj), (ci+1,cj), (ci,cj-1), (ci,cj+1))
                end
                push!(components, comp)
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Build deflation vectors
    defl_list = Vector{Float64}[]
    
    # Component indicators (limit to avoid too many)
    max_comp = 100
    for idx in 1:min(length(components), max_comp)
        comp = components[idx]
        v = zeros(n)
        for i in comp
            v[i] = 1.0
        end
        nrm = norm(v)
        if nrm > 1e-10
            v ./= nrm
            push!(defl_list, v)
        end
    end
    
    # Geometric 8x8 aggregates
    agg_size = 8
    Nc = div(N, agg_size)
    
    for jc in 1:Nc
        for ic in 1:Nc
            v = zeros(n)
            j0 = agg_size*(jc-1) + 1
            i0 = agg_size*(ic-1) + 1
            for dj in 0:(agg_size-1)
                for di in 0:(agg_size-1)
                    i_f = i0 + di
                    j_f = j0 + dj
                    if i_f <= N && j_f <= N
                        f = i_f + N*(j_f-1)
                        v[f] = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    n_defl = length(defl_list)
    
    # Orthogonalize via modified Gram-Schmidt
    Q = zeros(n, n_defl)
    for i in 1:n_defl
        q = copy(defl_list[i])
        for j in 1:i-1
            proj = zero(eltype(q))
            for l in 1:n
                proj += Q[l,j] * q[l]
            end
            for l in 1:n
                q[l] -= proj * Q[l,j]
            end
        end
        nrm = norm(q)
        if nrm > 1e-10
            for l in 1:n
                Q[l,i] = q[l] / nrm
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Build coarse matrix A_c = Q^T * A * Q
    A_c = zeros(n_defl, n_defl)
    temp = zeros(n)
    for j in 1:n_defl
        fill!(temp, 0.0)
        matvec!(temp, P, Q[:,j])
        for i in 1:n_defl
            s = zero(eltype(temp))
            for l in 1:n
                s += Q[l,i] * temp[l]
            end
            A_c[i,j] = s
        end
    end
    
    # Symmetrize and regularize
    for j in 1:n_defl
        for i in 1:j
            A_c[i,j] = A_c[j,i] = 0.5 * (A_c[i,j] + A_c[j,i])
        end
    end
    
    reg = 1e-10
    for i in 1:n_defl
        A_c[i,i] += reg
    end
    
    F = cholesky(A_c)
    
    return (Q=Q, F=F, n_defl=n_defl)
end

I need to improve on the current two-level deflation method. The key issues are: (1) the coarse space isn't capturing the channels well enough at high contrast, (2) the solver is essentially stationary and needs more acceleration, and (3) the momentum term helps but isn't enough.

My approach: **Adaptive multiscale coarse space with Krylov acceleration**. Instead of just indicator functions for high-k components, I'll use energy-minimizing basis functions that decay smoothly into the background. I'll also add a Krylov subspace component using the residual, making this more like a deflated preconditioned conjugate gradient rather than a stationary method. The key insight is that for high contrast channels, we need basis functions that can represent gradients across channel boundaries, not just piecewise constants.

# Energy-minimizing multiscale coarse space with deflated CG-like acceleration

const THETA0 = [0.9, 1.5, 0.9, 0.3, 0.05, 0.8]

    components = Vector{Int}[]
    
    for j in 1:N
        for i in 1:N
            if !visited[i,j] && k[i,j] > k_threshold
                comp = Int[]
                stack = [(i,j)]
                while !isempty(stack)
                    ci, cj = pop!(stack)
                    (ci < 1 || ci > N || cj < 1 || cj > N) && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] && continue
                    k[ci,cj] <= k_threshold && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] = true
                    push!(comp, ci + N*(cj-1))
                    push!(stack, (ci-1,cj), (ci+1,cj), (ci,cj-1), (ci,cj+1))
                end
                push!(components, comp)
            end
        end

    # Build multiscale basis: energy-minimizing extensions
    # Start with piecewise constants on aggregates, then enrich with channel modes
    
    defl_list = Vector{Vector{Float64}}()

    for jc in 1:Nc
        for ic in 1:Nc
            v = zeros(n)
            j0 = agg_size*(jc-1) + 1
            i0 = agg_size*(ic-1) + 1
            for dj in 0:(agg_size-1)
                for di in 0:(agg_size-1)
                    i_f = i0 + di
                    j_f = j0 + dj
                    if i_f <= N && j_f <= N
                        f = i_f + N*(j_f-1)
                        v[f] = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Add edge basis functions between aggregates (bilinear hat functions)
    # These help capture gradients
    for jc in 1:(Nc-1)
        for ic in 1:Nc
            # horizontal edge
            v = zeros(n)
            j0 = agg_size*jc + 1  # boundary between aggregates
            i0 = agg_size*(ic-1) + 1
            for dj in -1:1  # small support across edge
                for di in 0:(agg_size-1)
                    i_f = i0 + di
                    j_f = j0 + dj
                    if i_f <= N && j_f >= 1 && j_f <= N
                        f = i_f + N*(j_f-1)
                        weight = 1.0 - abs(dj) / 2.0
                        v[f] = weight
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end

        for ic in 1:(Nc-1)
            # vertical edge
            v = zeros(n)
            j0 = agg_size*(jc-1) + 1
            i0 = agg_size*ic + 1
            for dj in 0:(agg_size-1)
                for di in -1:1
                    i_f = i0 + di
                    j_f = j0 + dj
                    if i_f >= 1 && i_f <= N && j_f <= N
                        f = i_f + N*(j_f-1)
                        weight = 1.0 - abs(di) / 2.0
                        v[f] = weight
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Add high-k component indicators (up to a limit)
    max_comp = 30
    for idx in 1:min(length(components), max_comp)
        comp = components[idx]
        v = zeros(n)
        for i in comp

        end
        nrm = norm(v)

            v ./= nrm
            push!(defl_list, v)
        end
    end

    Q = zeros(n, n_defl)
    temp = zeros(n)
    
    for i in 1:n_defl
        q = copy(defl_list[i])
        for j in 1:i-1
            proj = zero(eltype(q))
            @simd for l in 1:n
                proj += Q[l,j] * q[l]
            end
            @simd for l in 1:n
                q[l] -= proj * Q[l,j]
            end
        end
        nrm = norm(q)

            @simd for l in 1:n
                Q[l,i] = q[l] * invnrm
            end
        end
    end

    for j in 1:n_defl

        matvec!(temp, P, Q[:,j])
        for i in 1:j

            @simd for l in 1:n

            end

        end
    end

    for j in 1:n_defl
        for i in 1:j
            A_c[j,i] = A_c[i,j]
        end
    end
    
    # Regularize and factorize
    reg = 1e-12
    for i in 1:n_defl
        A_c[i,i] += reg
    end
    
    F = cholesky(A_c)
    
    # Precompute diagonal inverse for smoother
    dinv = 1.0 ./ P.diag

                    end

            end

                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    n_defl = length(defl_list)
    
    # Orthogonalize with modified Gram-Schmidt
    Q = zeros(n, n_defl)
    for i in 1:n_defl
        q = copy(defl_list[i])
        for j in 1:i-1
            proj = zero(eltype(q))
            @simd for l in 1:n
                proj += Q[l,j] * q[l]
            end
            @simd for l in 1:n
                q[l] -= proj * Q[l,j]
            end
        end
        nrm = norm(q)
        if nrm > 1e-10
            invnrm = 1.0 / nrm
            @simd for l in 1:n
                Q[l,i] = q[l] * invnrm
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Build coarse matrix A_c = Q^T A Q
    A_c = zeros(n_defl, n_defl)
    temp = zeros(n)
    for j in 1:n_defl
        fill!(temp, 0.0)
        matvec!(temp, P, Q[:,j])
        for i in 1:j
            s = zero(eltype(temp))
            @simd for l in 1:n
                s += Q[l,i] * temp[l]
            end
            A_c[i,j] = s
        end
    end
    
    # Symmetrize
    for j in 1:n_defl
        for i in 1:j
            A_c[j,i] = A_c[i,j]
        end
    end
    
    # Regularize for stability
    reg = 1e-12 * abs(A_c[1,1])
    for i in 1:n_defl
        A_c[i,i] += reg
    end
    
    F = cholesky(A_c)
    
    return (Q=Q, F=F, n_defl=n_defl)
end

# Coarse space: high-k channel components + geometric 4x4 aggregates.
# Smoother: damped Jacobi with tuned weight, applied symmetrically pre/post coarse correction.
# Precomputed A*Q for efficient coarse residual computation.

    # CG state
    p::Vector{Float64}
    rz_prev::Float64
    first_step::Bool
    
    # Preconditioner state
    Q::Matrix{Float64}
    AQ::Matrix{Float64}
    F::Cholesky{Float64, Matrix{Float64}}
    n_defl::Int
    temp_n::Vector{Float64}
    temp_n2::Vector{Float64}
    temp_d::Vector{Float64}
    dinv::Vector{Float64}

function prepare(P)
    N = P.N
    n = N * N
    k = P.k
    
    k_max = maximum(k)
    k_threshold_default = sqrt(k_max)
    
    # Find connected components of high-k cells
    visited = falses(N, N)
    components = Vector{Int}[]
    
    for j in 1:N
        for i in 1:N
            if !visited[i,j] && k[i,j] > k_threshold_default
                comp = Int[]
                stack = [(i,j)]
                while !isempty(stack)
                    ci, cj = pop!(stack)
                    (ci < 1 || ci > N || cj < 1 || cj > N) && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] && continue
                    k[ci,cj] <= k_threshold_default && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] = true
                    push!(comp, ci + N*(cj-1))
                    push!(stack, (ci-1,cj), (ci+1,cj), (ci,cj-1), (ci,cj+1))
                end
                push!(components, comp)
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Build deflation vectors
    defl_list = Vector{Vector{Float64}}()
    
    # High-k channel components
    max_comp = 100
    for idx in 1:min(length(components), max_comp)
        comp = components[idx]
        v = zeros(n)
        for i in comp
            v[i] = 1.0
        end
        nrm = norm(v)
        if nrm > 1e-10
            v ./= nrm
            push!(defl_list, v)
        end
    end
    
    # Geometric 4x4 aggregates
    agg_size = 4
    Nc = div(N, agg_size)
    
    for jc in 1:Nc
        for ic in 1:Nc
            v = zeros(n)
            j0 = agg_size*(jc-1) + 1
            i0 = agg_size*(ic-1) + 1
            for dj in 0:(agg_size-1)
                for di in 0:(agg_size-1)
                    i_f = i0 + di
                    j_f = j0 + dj
                    if i_f <= N && j_f <= N
                        f = i_f + N*(j_f-1)
                        v[f] = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    n_defl = length(defl_list)
    
    # Orthogonalize with modified Gram-Schmidt
    Q = zeros(n, n_defl)
    for i in 1:n_defl
        q = copy(defl_list[i])
        for j in 1:i-1
            proj = zero(eltype(q))
            @simd for l in 1:n
                proj += Q[l,j] * q[l]
            end
            @simd for l in 1:n
                q[l] -= proj * Q[l,j]
            end
        end
        nrm = norm(q)
        if nrm > 1e-10
            invnrm = 1.0 / nrm
            @simd for l in 1:n

            end
        end

    # Precompute A * Q

        matvec!(AQ[:,j], P, Q[:,j])
    end
    
    # Build coarse matrix A_c = Q^T A Q = Q^T * AQ
    A_c = zeros(n_defl, n_defl)
    for j in 1:n_defl

        for i in 1:j
            A_c[j,i] = A_c[i,j]

    for i in 1:n_defl
        A_c[i,i] += reg
    end
    
    F = cholesky(A_c)
    
    return (Q=Q, AQ=AQ, F=F, n_defl=n_defl)

# Smoother: damped Jacobi with tuned weight, applied symmetrically pre/post coarse correction.

    visited = falses(N, N)
    components = Vector{Int}[]
    
    for j in 1:N

                while !isempty(stack)
                    ci, cj = pop!(stack)
                    (ci < 1 || ci > N || cj < 1 || cj > N) && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] && continue
                    k[ci,cj] <= k_threshold && continue
                    visited[ci,cj] = true
                    push!(comp, ci + N*(cj-1))
                    push!(stack, (ci-1,cj), (ci+1,cj), (ci,cj-1), (ci,cj+1))
                end
                push!(components, comp)
            end
        end
    end

        end

            v ./= nrm
            push!(defl_list, v)
        end

            i0 = agg_size*(ic-1) + 1

                        v[f] = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
            nrm = norm(v)
            if nrm > 1e-10
                v ./= nrm
                push!(defl_list, v)
            end
        end
    end
    
    n_defl = length(defl_list)
    
    # Orthogonalize with modified Gram-Schmidt
    Q = zeros(n, n_defl)
    for i in 1:n_defl
        q = copy(defl_list[i])

            end
        end
    end

        fill!(AQ[:,j], 0.0)

    end

            @simd for l in 1:n

            end

            A_c[j,i] = A_c[i,j]
        end

    @inbounds for j in 1:n_defl
        qj = w_c * S.temp_d[j]
        @simd for i in 1:n
            S.Ad[i] += S.AQ[i,j] * qj
        end
    end

    @simd for i in 1:n
        S.temp_n2[i] = r[i] - S.Ad[i]
    end

    @simd for i in 1:n
        S.temp_n[i] += ω * S.dinv[i] * S.temp_n2[i]
    end
    
    # z is now the preconditioned residual
    z = S.temp_n
    
    # PCG update
    rz = dot(r, z)
    
    if S.first_step
        S.p .= z
        S.first_step = false
    else

            S.p[i] = z[i] + beta * S.p[i]

    end

    matvec!(S.Ad, P, S.p)

    end
